purpose: Test whether routing only ready sink functions to OCS can reduce workflow-closing latency and cost while faithful FaaSRank retains throughput on all nonterminal stages.

diagnosis_frozen_before_implementation.code_level_mechanistic_difference: OCS has the lowest mean latency and a lower mean cost than V82, while FaaSRank has the highest throughput. A ready sink function is the only placement that can immediately close a workflow after execution; internal functions still feed downstream work.
diagnosis_frozen_before_implementation.root_cause_hypothesis: Pipelining half of the frontier before parent completion increased congestion and cost. Reverting to PreAllDone and applying the OCS warm-affinity/low-load rule only to sink functions can target the workflow-closing latency-cost product without displacing FaaSRank from throughput-bearing internal stages.

candidate.player_frontier: PreAllDone: every parent of a scheduled function has completed
candidate.terminal_predicate: a function is a sink iff no function in the immutable captured DAG names it as a parent; this uses topology only and has no numeric threshold
candidate.initializer: native request/DAG player order; nonterminal players use the frozen faithful FaaSRank score, deterministic epsilon selection and actual-selection rolling history; terminal players use the exact frozen OCS current-demand score and the same deterministic node tie-break
candidate.coordination: unchanged paper-utility best response produces a proposal; an atomic whole-window guard accepts it only when immutable-baseline paper social welfare strictly improves and the complete-assignment routed-expert score is nonworse within EPSILON, otherwise it restores the initializer

sink detection returns true exactly when a function has no child in the immutable captured DAG
nonterminal initialization uses the faithful FaaSRank score and deterministic selection path
terminal initialization uses the exact OCS current-demand penalty without changing the OCS baseline
rolling FaaSRank history is updated with every actual selected node, including terminal OCS selections

execution_order: Commit this plan before modifying scheduler code or generating any E590-E619 artifact.
Implement only the single terminal-OCS profile and required observability; do not change any baseline, paper utility, reference search, common HPA, workload or environment weight.
Pass focused topology/initializer/guard tests, all sche_nash tests, rustfmt, cargo check and release build; freeze source commit and binary hash before input generation.
Generate only E590-E599 screen inputs; capture each base tape once and bind identical derived tapes to all ten methods.
Build exactly ten state-matched candidate references, then execute ninety baselines and ten candidate runs strictly serially without opening intermediate QC or performance output.
Require 100 attempt-one QC passes, zero quarantine, exact ten-way pairing, one runtime identity and a result-free joint audit before simultaneous reveal.
If and only if all three arithmetic-mean gates pass, freeze the unchanged candidate and commit a confirmation execution receipt before generating E600-E619 inputs.
If any gate fails, retain all artifacts, do not tune on E590-E599, generate no E600-E619 inputs and close the terminal-OCS family.

analysis.throughput: Arithmetic mean fixed-window throughput across all ten E590-E599 seeds.
analysis.qpr_finite_only: Arithmetic mean per-run fixed-window throughput divided by drained-cohort mean latency and cost across finite positive-completion runs.
analysis.qpr_zero_completed_as_zero: The same per-run QPR with undefined or zero-completion runs assigned zero over all ten seeds.
analysis.baseline_threshold: For each metric, the largest arithmetic mean among the nine same-seed baselines.
analysis.screen_gate: The candidate must strictly exceed all three baseline thresholds; ties fail.
analysis.paired_uncertainty: Report candidate-minus-each-baseline paired BCa 95% intervals without changing the arithmetic-mean gate.
analysis.mechanism_diagnostics: After the joint blind audit, report terminal/nonterminal player counts, guard disposition and score/welfare deltas; they cannot alter the frozen decision.
analysis.screen_success_action: Authorize preparation, but not success, of the untouched E600-E619 formal confirmation block.
analysis.screen_failure_action: Retain every artifact, do not tune on E590-E599, generate no confirmation inputs and close the terminal-OCS family.
